name: The Blackbox
subtitle: Spacious Karoo Living with a Shower
description: Our larger room Blackbox is perfect for those who appreciate a bit more space, just 6km from the Karoo National Park. This room has all you need for a comfortable stay, featuring a shower bathroom and a basic kitchenette perfect for lingering meals while on the road. Blackbox is where space meets comfort.
